name: PNG-based Gaussian Compression
aliases: Compact 3D Scene Representation via Self-Organizing Gaussian Grids
definition: Lossless compression of trained Gaussian splat models by quantizing splat parameters into 8-bit and 16-bit PNG images, combined with Morton-code spatial sorting to achieve ~10x compression on standard 3DGS models.
summary: PNG-based Gaussian Compression quantizes 3D Gaussian splat parameters into lossless PNG images to achieve approximately 10x compression, distinguishing itself by using spatial sorting and NPZ for higher-order bands due to MLX framework constraints.
